outcome: clinical pattern of various dermatoses in neonates
diagnostic value of skin manifestations in neonates
cohort: 100 neonates within the first 72 hours of life.
finding: Majority of the skin manifestation within 72 hours after birth are either physiological or benign that last for sometimes.
birth_weight: 79% had normal birth weight (2.5-3.5 kg) and 21% had low birth weight (<2.5kg)
